# Smart File Organizer

## Description
Smart File Organizer is a Python desktop application that automatically organizes files into folders based on their file type.

## Features
- Browse Folder
- Organize Files
- View History
- Search History
- Export History
- Clear History
- Statistics Dashboard
- Undo Last Move
- Progress Bar
- Menu Bar

## Technologies
- Python
- Tkinter
- SQLite
- CSV
- OS
- shutil
